claims.claim: CoreWeave Q2 2026 revenue was $2.575B versus $1.212B a year earlier; revenue backlog was about $104B and contracted power reached about 3.7GW.

factors.name: AI compute demand
factors.basis: revenue, backlog and contracted-power expansion show unusually strong AI-infrastructure demand

risks.risk: Rapid capacity build requires very high capital intensity and depends on data-center, power and GPU supply execution.

causalEdges.mechanism: customers reserve compute and power capacity through committed contracts
causalEdges.falsifier: backlog cancellations, utilization weakness or power/GPU delivery constraints materially slow revenue conversion

unknowns.unknown: Customer concentration and backlog cancellation/termination economics require underwriting.

claims.claim: Adjusted EBITDA reached $1.510B, but GAAP operating loss was $49M, net loss was $626M and net interest expense was $640M in Q2 2026.

factors.name: execution versus financing burden
factors.basis: scale and adjusted EBITDA are strong while GAAP losses and interest burden remain substantial

risks.risk: Debt-funded infrastructure expansion can make equity outcomes sensitive to financing cost, utilization and contract conversion.

causalEdges.mechanism: new GPU infrastructure enables revenue but creates interest and fixed-capital obligations
causalEdges.falsifier: operating cash generation persistently outgrows financing burden and leverage falls

unknowns.unknown: No canonical valuation or normalized free-cash-flow conclusion is asserted.
